plan_digest_rule: SHA256 of the complete exact final nineteen-TestManifest/Gate suite bytes; each case setup and oracle remains in this plan, not in the fixture identity

fixture_set.scope: The unique fixed primitive contains the exact synthetic fixture literal. This does not assert it executes nineteen cases or proves Skill behavior.
fixture_set.invalidation: Any added or changed fixture requires a forward exact fixture-set definition/digest and independent applicability review
